args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

Previously round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming
banker's rounding, causing nightly tests/test_money.py to fail.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` — contradicting its own docstring.

## Change
- Imported `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `src/money.py`
- `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (e.g. `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
